description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken creature, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl's first ability by paying {G}, causing the creature to become a 1/1 creature that is still a land until end of turn.
Repeat.
